name: pwdev-video-tutorial
description: Explainer and tutorial videos of software systems built from the real system: code scan plus live navigation with playwright-cli, system map, video roadmap, storytelling scripts, free local pt-BR narration, screen recording with chapters, highlights and blurred personal data, and assembly with captions and click zoom through pwdev-video-hyperframes, plus a text tutorial.

interface.shortDescription: Tutorial and explainer videos of a real system
interface.longDescription: Read the codebase and navigate the system with playwright-cli to map screens, flows and permissions; plan a roadmap of videos by audience and priority; write storytelling scripts with verified locators; narrate with a free local pt-BR voice; record the screen with chapters, highlights and blurred personal data; assemble the final video with readable captions and click zoom; and export a text tutorial with screenshots.
defaultPrompt: Explore https://staging.example.com and the code in ./app, then propose a roadmap of tutorial videos.
Write the script for the 'create a customer' tutorial.
Record and assemble the tutorial video V02.
